name: Koplin Compact
description: The treaty framework coordinating transit law, commercial standards and shared infrastructure across much of the Koplin Reach.

name: Helix Industrial Group
description: A major aerospace and engineering group producing propulsion systems, advanced alloys and spacecraft components.

name: Verdant Horizon Biotech
description: A specialist bioscience organisation developing closed-habitat crops, nutritional cultures and biological support systems.

name: Meridian Exchange Authority
description: The semi-autonomous authority governing Meridian's freeport zones and commodity exchange rules.

name: Meridian Logistics Cooperative
description: A carrier and warehousing cooperative moving a large share of the Reach's containerised freight.

name: Asterion Shipworks
description: The Reach's best-known independent shipbuilder, producing commercial hulls, state vessels and specialised survey craft.

visualIdentity.style: exposed structural ribs and clean shipyard markings

name: Orison Institute for Machine Cognition
description: A public research institute studying machine cognition, synthetic embodiment and human-AI collaboration.

name: Orison Cognition Assembly
description: A recognised political body representing persistent synthetic citizens and machine communities across Orison.

name: Caldera Materials Consortium
description: A consortium of high-temperature refiners and advanced-material producers centred on Caldera Prime.

name: Halcyon Habitat Group
description: A major habitat developer responsible for much of Haven's orbital residential expansion.

name: Nacre Biosystems
description: A marine-bioscience company deriving specialist compounds and industrial cultures from Nacre's ocean ecosystems.

name: Damaris Frontier Authority
description: The civil authority managing Damaris exploration licences, frontier settlement and shared infrastructure.

name: Damaris Security Command
description: A joint security force protecting frontier traffic, rescue corridors and strategic infrastructure.

name: Lattice Interstellar Bank
description: A major inter-system bank financing infrastructure, ship construction and commodity contracts across the Reach.

name: Farline News Network
description: A widely followed independent news network with correspondents throughout the Reach.

name: Koplin General Medical Trust
description: A public medical trust operating major hospitals and emergency-transfer services around Koplin.

name: Inter-System Dockworkers Guild
description: A cross-system guild representing dock, freight-handling and yard workers at major Reach ports.

name: Koplin Resource Charter Corporation
description: A major charter corporation financing and contracting remote mining colonies, then purchasing output into the Reach economy.

visualIdentity.style: practical corporate mining and logistics design
